import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'

root = tree.getroot()
ifaces = root.find('interfaces')

    el = ET.SubElement(ifaces, name)
    ET.SubElement(el, 'enable').text = '1'
    ET.SubElement(el, 'if').text = ifname
    ET.SubElement(el, 'ipaddr').text = ip
    ET.SubElement(el, 'subnet').text = subnet

make('opt2', 'vtnet2', '10.60.20.1', '24', 'LANB')
